facts.business: NCC Bluewater Products Limited had its project land and facilities compulsorily acquired by the Government of Andhra Pradesh and is considering restructuring its activities; currently it has no operational business segments.
key_risks: Compulsory acquisition of almost entire project land and facilities by Government of Andhra Pradesh
Company is considering restructuring its activities
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not entered into any related party transactions during the financial year 2025-26.
